items.title: Albert Morgan Interview, 1958-08-19
items.q: I was still with Sabah Lewis' band, see, up in Boston.

ctx.x: I was going to ask you to make a little message to your brothers, if you'd like to. I mean, I'm not... We forgot to mention the Esquire. You might mention that.

Yes. Yes, Esquire. That was in the... I was still with Sabah Lewis' band, see, up in Boston. I didn't know anything about it, told several fans. One night I was up in Portland, Maine, playing a Saturday night dance out on the... the Old Archie, Old Archie Beach. So they asked me, says, gee, I heard you made Esquire. I says, I don't know. He says, sure. And one of the fans had the poll, you know. So, gee, I says, well, I'm glad somebody thought of me. He says, you... Yes, boy. She says, I know everybody. They…
That's a great big award. We might take a picture of it so we can see it.
